captions.instagram:
Your kids help in the business? The IRS has specific rules for paying them.

✔️ A child under 18 working for a parent's sole proprietorship (or a partnership owned only by the parents) doesn't owe Social Security or Medicare tax on those wages.
✔️ Under 21, no federal unemployment tax either.
✔️ If the business is a corporation, all the usual payroll taxes apply.
✔️ The child's own 2026 standard deduction is $16,100, which can cover wages when they have no other income.
✔️ The work has to be real and the pay reasonable. Keep timesheets and pay by transfer.

State rules vary. We check whether it fits your business in a year-end planning session.
